_doc: Exceptions to the GP-407 8px spacing rule (scripts/spacing-grid.mjs). Each entry matches {file, prop, value}; every entry needs a reason, and an entry that no longer matches fails the test.

entries.reason: icon geometry: the hamburger glyph's top bar, drawn 6px above the middle bar (not layout spacing)
icon geometry: the hamburger glyph's bottom bar, 6px below the middle bar
icon geometry: the open state folds the top bar onto the middle bar (must equal the bar offset)
icon geometry: the open state folds the bottom bar onto the middle bar (must equal the bar offset)
motion: the toast's 4px pop nudge while a new alert lands, not a spacing offset
motion: the scroll cue arrow's bounce keyframe
motion: the scroll cue arrow's bounce keyframes (60% and 100%)
SVG user units (transform-box: view-box): the logo letters start one glyph height below the 420-unit viewBox (entry animation)
SVG user units: the board-flip overshoot keyframe of the logo letters
